mission.objective: Implement a small SYNTHETIC-ONLY mathematical reference and regression suite for the written P15 M1 protocol. No real data loading, neural fitting, source discovery, or Git operations.

instructions.context: Read SCIENTIFIC_PROTOCOL.md, FEATURE_MODELS.md, SOURCE_QC.md, NUMERICAL_POLICY.json, NUMERICAL_SELECTION.md, STATISTICS_CONTROLS.md and COHORT.csv in this directory. All scientific definitions are prospective; do not change them. Implement only small reusable synthetic mathematical oracles; not an actual scientific model-fitting worker. No data outside this directory. Absolute paths to the real repository must not be read. No large framework. Use Python unittest, numpy/scipy/autograd. Parent will install dependencies and execute tests, so no installation, no commands accessing real data, no package network requests needed. Never modify an existing file; only the four exact allowed new files. Do not spawn agents or contact other threads. Do not stage/commit/push. Parent performs all review/Git gates.
requirements: synthetic.py: small pure functions for parameter_counts(U,K,r), Poisson log mass with exposure+factorial, analytic penalized Poisson GLM objective/gradient per T (not TU), outward-gradient projected gradient, deterministic chronological trial partition and boundary guards, causal lag features on toy bin arrays with explicit resets/invalid gaps, past-only wheel/event lookup helper, log-space conditional HMM forward using initial pre-bin pi and transition (warmup conditional score), IID mixture, brute enumerated small HMM oracle, exact sign-flip p, Holm, deterministic seed and count-preserving circular surrogate helper. No optimizers or real-data readers. Main dimensions match 37nuisance,4historyperunit; counts8,304,336,528,560,D571/584,C568/576,S578/587 atU8. Keep tiny and understandable.

test_contract.py: compact meaningful synthetic unittest tests for normalization/factorial, each nesting identity/parameter count, correct box gradient signs including outward/inward, analytic vs independent autograd derivative and ALL fixed central-FD steps1e-4,1e-5,1e-6 with fixed thresholds (record errors), HMM log forward vs independently enumerated tiny2state3-4bin sequences including conditional warmup, IID-HMM==static mixture and persistent-HMM generally differs, causal lag/current-future-neural perturbation invariance, backward wheel future-sample perturbation invariance and event timestamp availability, reset/gap handling, finite likelihood at toy bounds, fixed cohort12/8 no pilot inFinal, chronological partition guard indices, exact sign-flip known examples/Holm including unavailablep1, null rotation preserving perunit counts, RNG repeatability. No tests that merely repeat implementation constants. All tests must test actual math/oracles and no masks with invalid counted aszero. Program must refuse or never import/open any real neural data. Source schema tests may read local text/COHORT/policy.

Allow test command python -m unittest test_contract -v when cwd paper15_m1. reproduce.ps1 accepts -Python optional, defaults ../paper15_m0/work/runtime/Scripts/python.exe (existing environment does not yet have autograd; parent will pass the newM1 runtime). It executes synthetic tests from correct working directory, denies networking at Python runner stage if possible, records a small JSON receipt to work/ (but do not create other files now), never reads M0 neural caches. Saved-only protocol/hash checks can be handled by parent separately. requirements.txt pin numpy2.4.6,scipy1.17.1,autograd1.8.0 only. UTF8explicit for all Python file text operations. Use LF. No comments claiming full real-worker certification.
